Food fortiﬁcation: Technological aspects


Which other technical factors are important in food fortiﬁcation?
Physical segregation
Dry food matrices may also suffer segregation (separation) of the fortiﬁcant particle from food particles, due to differences in sizes
and densities. This mainly affects food matrices with large particle sizes, such as sugar and some types of salt. To avoid segregation,
